name: TISI Inc.
summary: TISI Inc. provides information technology (IT) services in Japan and internationally. It operates through Offering Service Business, Business Process Management, Financial IT Business, Industrial IT Business, and Wide-area IT Solutions segments. The company provides knowledge-intensive IT services; outsourcing of IT technology, business know-how, and human resources solutions; promotes business and IT strategies together and support business promotion; considers and promotes initiatives and supports the promotion of business; professional IT services, including regional and client sites, and accumulate and develop solutions to support problem-solving and business promotion.
